name: Author
description: Represents the author of the CommentThreaded object.
remarks: Use the Author property of the CommentThreaded object to return the Author object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String that contains the display name of the specified comment author. Read-only.

properties.name: ProviderID
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the ID of the service providing the contact information. Read-only.

properties.name: UserID
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the user ID of the contact. Read-only.
